acceptanceCriteria: adding a SOL-V0 requirement with its enumeration passes without editing a count literal
removing an enumerated obligation still fails the test
body:
Reported by the hosts-mcp-panel lane on 2026-10-21 while adding SOL-V0-030. The test pins the number of self-observation obligations as the word "fourteen", so any new SOL-V0 requirement fails an unrelated package until the literal is edited.
Expected: the test derives the expected obligations from the spec or the requirement index and checks that each one is enumerated.
title: TestSelfObservationSpecEnumeratesEveryObligation hard-codes the SOL requirement count, so every new SOL requirement breaks internal/lrfrepo
